m.d: T-shirt is another way of spelling T-shirt.
A T-shirt is a light shirt made of cotton and short sleeves and can have a picture or logo.
T-shirts is another way of spelling T-shirts.
The tsar is the title of the Emperors of Russia before 1917.
m.e: Our tsar Alexander I of Russia saved us from Napoleon in 1812.

m.d: A tsunami is a very large water wave formed in the ocean and can destroy buildings and people, usually due to an earthquake or volcanic eruption.
